newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends down on import dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends down on import dlr demand.

text.p: Demand for dollars to cover imports drove the Sri Lankan rupee down to close at 57.03 despite high call money rates on Monday, dealers said.
"There was a lot of dollar buying in the market to cover a huge petroleum import bill," said Priyantha Seneviratne, a dealer at Hatton National Bank.
High interest rates of around 20 percent pushed the rupee up in morning trade to 56.92 after opening at 57.01.
The Central Bank moved the dollar down by half a cent, responding to its overseas weakness especially against the yen, fixing buying and selling rates at 55.9301/57.06.
